docs.title: Variables, Data Types, Libraries, Inputs and Output in C
Variables and Data Types
docs.text:
Variables refers to the data that will be used by the code in various means. C needs explicitly informing what data type it is storing in each variable, to ensure it can carry out subsequent calculations.

Data Type Description Example Size int Signed integer (whole numbers) int radius = 6; 16 or 32 bits char Single ASCII character or 8-bit integer char status = 'A'; 8 bits (1 byte) bool Boolean logic value (true or false)* bool is_ready = true; 8 bits (1 byte) float Single-precision floating-point number float voltage = 3.3f; 32 bits (4 bytes)
